svg.title: Broadcasting a column against a row
svg.desc: Three 3 by 4 grids. Tag 1, robots_x, shape (3, 1): the column 0.0, 2.5, 5.5, with faded copies of it in the other three columns. Tag 2, goals_x, shape (4,): the row 1.0, 3.0, 4.0, 6.0, with faded copies of it in the other two rows. A minus sign between them and an arrow to tag 3, dist, shape (3, 4), the absolute differences: rows 1.0 3.0 4.0 6.0; 1.5 0.5 1.5 3.5; 4.5 2.5 1.5 0.5.
